source: Isolated official SteamCMD package; read-only comparison against installed build 26172878. No native game execution in this review.

configuration.module_coverage: The 92 settings keys are represented by schema controls, including optional BackpackCleanup, WeaponDurabilityMulti and HeadshotOnlyMode overrides. RConPort is owned by the port model. Version is the reference-file identifier and is intentionally not rendered. RecycleCar is rendered once.

rcon_reference.save_contract: The shipped reference still describes save as Save game and provides no durable-completion protocol. The existing fixed HumanitZ ACK parser expects packet ID 1 and Game saved!, while the application retains Requested. This review does not establish that the new binary returns that ACK or that it persists world data.

scope: The acquired manifest matches the public branch metadata queried on 2026-10-31. No configuration or documented RCON command delta requires adaptation. Steam build identity and REF Version 39 do not establish a human-readable release version. Native readiness, authenticated info/save exchanges, persistence, shutdown and recovery still require separate verification; earlier runtime evidence is unchanged.
